text: Two new levels below Beginner for people who have just learnt the moves, and the app asks your level on first launch. Practice and challenge modes: challenge games count towards your rating, with no hints or take-backs. Review a finished game as a graph of how it went, with your costliest move and the better one marked. Endgame practice now has 30 studies from the classical manuals, mates in 2 to 12. English interface with WXF notation. The evaluation stays hidden unless you turn it on.
新增新手、入门两档，适合刚学会走棋的人；第一次打开会先问你的水平。分练习与挑战两种模式：挑战计入积分，不能提示和悔棋。下完一局可以复盘，看整局的形势走势图，图上标出你代价最大的一步，棋盘上画出更好的走法。残局练习换成 30 道古谱原局（适情雅趣、梦入神机等），2 到 12 步杀，解不出可以看答案。新增英文界面。形势分默认隐藏，可在「更多」里打开。回放改为棋盘下方的按钮条。
